existingRuntimeRequirements: P4 checkpoint envelope: strict field allowlist (checkpoint-integrity.mjs), dual digest (runtime_state_digest over canonical runtime_state, integrity.payload_digest over envelope minus integrity)
identity: checkpoint_id chk_* path-safe, run_ref path-safe, sequence >= 1, task_ref identity-binding to runtime_state.task_ref
compatibility: resume DENIES unknown contract_version/runtime_version (no best-effort coercion)
externalSpecRequirements: Master spec (external, non-normative): durable checkpointing must be independently machine-validatable
ownerDisposition: P8 contract alignment: this schema DESCRIBES the existing P4 envelope; it invents no new runtime semantics
inline JS validators remain the semantic authority (runtimeStatus deferred: the runtime does not consume this schema)
newInference: runtime_version/contract_version are pinned to the values the current runtime writes (0.1.0/1.0.0); a future version change is a contract change requiring explicit owner disposition

title: CLG Checkpoint Envelope
description: Machine-validatable projection of the persisted checkpoint envelope produced by runtime/kernel/checkpoint-store.mjs since CLG-P4. Deep runtime_state semantics are owned by clg-runtime-state.json and enforced inline; this contract covers the envelope surface and integrity metadata.

runtime_state.description: Deep semantics owned by core/contracts/clg-runtime-state.json; enforced inline by validateRuntimeState including task_ref identity binding to the envelope.
